title: valeriana montana subsp. tripteris
intro: Valeriana montana subsp. tripteris, commonly known as the Tripteris Valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Tripteris Valerian include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana montana subsp. tripteris include valepotriates, isovaleramide, and other valerenic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
